reason: Adds an About panel that displays DSH environment details and checks npm registry versions, persists the last result locally, and does not perform upgrades.

summaries.zh: 在 DSH 设置页新增关于面板，展示本地环境信息并通过 npm 检查版本更新，同时保存上次检测结果。
summaries.en: Adds an About panel to display local DSH environment details, check npm for available versions, and persist the last check result.

capabilities: Displays local version and runtime information
Queries npm registry version tags through a same-origin host endpoint
Reads and writes the persisted last-check result in a local JSON file
Provides an interface for copying upgrade commands and opening the npm page
